title: Rule Builders for Every Validation Rule in Laravel 13.36
content:
Laravel 13.36 adds Rule:: builders for the remaining validation rules, DB::olap() for PlanetScale, and an option to reset sticky connections between queue jobs.

The post Rule Builders for Every Validation Rule in Laravel 13.36 appeared first on Laravel News.
